{{Quote|According to information from the droid, two ruthless Imperial generals are present at an Imperial base on Dantooine as is an assassin who has been hired to take out General Dodonna and Admiral Ackbar. You must eliminate these threats to the Rebel Alliance.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="SWG:HGUDY" />}}
The '''Dantooine Imperial base''', also known as the '''Imperial Bunker''', located in the [[Taikaha Hills]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] was in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], this bunker served as the base of operations for [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Kehel Sinan]] and [[Stromgald Rholar]], as well as an Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] named [[Barthis Belangus]]. After it was realized that the generals posed a dire threat to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and Belangus had intentions of assassinating General [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] tasked a Rebel operative with [[Death/Legends|killing]] the three of them.<ref name="SWG:HGUDY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dantooine Imperial base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HGUDY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Base was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:HGUDY" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
